facebook.caption:
This place fixes the noise in your head.

Dinh Cậu is a small sea goddess shrine perched at the edge of the harbor. Blue-and-white lighthouse behind you. fishing boats below. Phu Quoc slowing down in front of you.

Come at sunset. Stay longer than you planned. 4.5 stars across 3,778 reviews, and you'll see why the moment you arrive.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
